theorem lg_target (x : ENNReal) (y : ℝ) : x ^ y = (↑y * x.log).exp := by
  have log_eq : (x ^ y).log = ↑y * x.log := ENNReal.log_rpow x y
  rw [log_eq]
  have real_exp_eq : (↑y * x.log).exp = x ^ y :=
    by
      cases x with a
      · rcases a with ⟨a, h⟩
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos h y]
      · exact eq_self_iff_true.1 (ENNReal.exp_zero _)
  rw [real_exp_eq]
